text: Project core is the website: Markdown pages plus tool ACI, not a 3b1b night-mode wall.
Papers are a permanent DB (data/papers + /api/papers/db). Forgetting never applies to papers.
Fetch code on demand from math or diagram queries; store bidirectional maps in data/maps.
User and project long-term memory use half-life decay (Ebbinghaus-style). Touch to strengthen.
Open on iPad creates a metadata-tied pad board. Autosave never writes MD. Park still goes through the drawing-loop agent.
